title: Grothendieck–Katz p-Curvature Conjecture
exact_target: Does vanishing $p$-curvature at almost every prime force a characteristic-zero differential equation to have only algebraic solutions and finite monodromy?

sources.citation: Benson Farb and Mark Kisin, The Grothendieck–Katz Conjecture for Certain Locally Symmetric Varieties.
